title: Patriots' Mike Vrabel has blunt response to reported $250,000 fine: 'Talk to the league'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots' Mike Vrabel has blunt response to reported $250,000 fine: 'Talk to the league'
sources.description: New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said "talk to the league" about his reported $250,000 fine that was supposed to remain "confidential."
